description: Get the DJ/artist schedule for a festival or party event. Returns set times, stages, and artists. Use this to answer questions like 'What time does ANOTR play?' or 'What's happening at AYA on New Year's Eve?'

artist.description: Search for specific artist in the schedule

event_id.description: UUID of the event to get schedule for

event_name.description: Name of the event to search for (if event_id not known)

name: get_event_schedule
